values.meaning: magic damage dealt in AoE slash when retrieving a dagger
values.binNote: Bin's ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart is unresolved so the base can't be directly verified; the AP ratio list (byLevelL[0.7...1]) matches. The wiki's pplevel string lists 20 entries (through 257/275) while champion levels only run 1-18, so only the first 18 are used here; the trailing two entries are unexplained by the sheet.

values.meaning: percent of Shunpo's total cooldown refunded as current cooldown on dagger pickup
values.quote: {{pp|key=%|78 to 96 for 4|1 to 16}} of its '''total''' cooldown

values.meaning: flat current cooldown reduction to all Katarina abilities on a takedown within 3s of damaging the target
values.quote: reduce the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Katarina's''' {{tip|abilities}} by 15 seconds
values.binNote: Not usable in the dummy fight (dummy cannot be taken down) but recorded since it directly reduces spell cooldowns.

mechanics.claim: Scoring a takedown within 3 seconds of damaging a target refunds current cooldowns on all of Katarina's abilities.
mechanics.quote: Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will reduce the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Katarina's''' {{tip|abilities}} by 15 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Retrieving a dagger triggers an AoE slash that deals magic damage and applies on-hit effects to enemy champions hit.
mechanics.quote: she slashes around herself to deal ... magic damage to nearby enemies, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects to enemy champions hit

mechanics.claim: Daggers still deal their slash damage even if dodged, but do not apply on-hit effects in that case.
mechanics.quote: {{as|Daggers|buzzword}} will still deal damage but not apply on-hit effects if {{tip|dodged}}.

mechanics.claim: Single-use on-hit effects (e.g. Spellblade) apply to the closest target to Katarina when a dagger is used, not necessarily the target that triggered the pickup.
mechanics.quote: Single-use on-hit effects, such as {{tip|Spellblade}}, will apply to the closest target to '''Katarina''' when she uses a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}.
